brief.claim: Firms with a larger payroll have lower staff turnover rates: across 250 firms, the proportion of variance in the annual turnover rate (leavers per employee) explained by the payroll (R squared of a simple linear regression) is at least 0.1.

data_keys.meaning: number of employees who left the firm during the year
